headlines.snippet: Sergeant Major Ron Jonathan Reutman and Sergeant Yuval Shai Sulaim fell in a terrorist attack at the Judah Crossroads. Reutman, 23, from Ashkelon, and Sulaim, 20, from Hod Hasharon, served in the Ari Battalion of the Combat Rescue Brigade. Three other soldiers sustained moderate and light injuries. The IDF estimates the terrorists planned a larger attack against civilians, which was thwarted by the soldiers' actions. The two terrorists were eliminated, and a foreign photographer is being investigated for prior knowledge of the attack. Netanyahu ordered an immediate lockdown of Hebron and preparations for a full closure in Judea and Samaria.
